name: SciPy / SymPy
use: ODEs, numerical integration, optimization, symbolic identities and conservation checks; equations are chosen from the problem.
required_validation: Units, initial/boundary conditions, tolerances, solver convergence and observation fit.

name: OpenMM + molecular viewer
use: Atomistic molecular dynamics when an admitted protein structure, force field and simulation protocol exist. A protein structure alone does not predict digestion or efficacy.
required_validation: Structure quality, protonation, force-field applicability, equilibration, timestep and independent biological evidence.

name: BioSimulators / SBML
use: Biochemical reaction networks and reproducible simulation experiments with model-format and solver compatibility.
required_validation: Model provenance, kinetic parameters, mass balance, identifiability and assay comparison.

name: Mesa
use: Agent-based mechanisms, heterogeneous agents, interaction networks and emergent population dynamics.
required_validation: Behavioral assumptions, update schedule, random seeds, aggregate and micro-level observables, sensitivity and external validation.

name: SUMO / TraCI
use: Transport-network simulation, traffic interactions and intervention scenarios using supplied networks and demand.
required_validation: Network geometry, calibrated demand, routing, speed/flow benchmarks and policy counterfactual assumptions.

name: QuantLib
use: Pricing and risk models with explicit instruments, market conventions, processes and calibration inputs. No trading connector is exposed.
required_validation: Market timestamps, contract conventions, no-lookahead splits, parameter stability and stress/scenario checks.

name: PyMC / ArviZ
use: Generative Bayesian models, parameter uncertainty, posterior prediction and hierarchical models.
required_validation: Prior predictive checks, convergence, effective sample size, identifiability, posterior predictive checks and held-out calibration.

name: NetworkX / RDFLib / SymPy
use: Graphs, typed relationships, symbolic constraints and coupled model representations.
required_validation: Entity identity, semantics, unit consistency, directionality and distinction between association and causality.
